name: @utdk/asana
description: Generated UTDK provider client for Asana. This is the interface for interacting with the [Asana Platform](https://developers.asana.com). Our API reference is generated from our [OpenAPI spec] (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asana/openapi/master/defs/asana_oas.yaml).

schemes.description: A personal access token allows access to the api for the user who created it. This should be kept a secret and be treated like a password.

We require that applications designed to access the Asana API on behalf of multiple users implement OAuth 2.0.
Asana supports the Authorization Code Grant flow.

scopes.default: Provides access to all endpoints documented in our API reference. If no scopes are requested, this scope is assumed by default.
scopes.openid: Provides access to OpenID Connect ID tokens and the OpenID Connect user info endpoint.
scopes.email: Provides access to the user’s email through the OpenID Connect user info endpoint.
scopes.profile: Provides access to the user’s name and profile photo through the OpenID Connect user info endpoint.
scopes.attachments:write: Create and modify access to attachments
scopes.custom_fields:write: Create and modify access to custom fields
scopes.ooo_entries:write: Create and modify access to OOO entries
scopes.tasks:write: Create and modify access to tasks
scopes.task_custom_types:read: View access to task custom types
scopes.portfolios:write: Create and modify access to portfolios
scopes.project_portfolio_settings:read: View access to project portfolio settings
scopes.project_portfolio_settings:write: Create and modify access to project portfolio settings
scopes.projects:write: Create and modify access to projects
scopes.roles:write: Create and modify access to roles
scopes.time_tracking_categories:read: View access to time tracking categories
scopes.time_tracking_categories:write: Create and modify access to time tracking categories
scopes.time_tracking_categories:delete: Delete access to time tracking categories
scopes.time_tracking_entries:read: View access to time tracking entries
scopes.timesheet_approval_statuses:read: View access to timesheet approval statuses
scopes.timesheet_approval_statuses:write: Create and modify access to timesheet approval statuses
scopes.stories:write: Create and modify access to stories
scopes.tags:write: Create and modify access to tags
scopes.webhooks:write: Create and modify access to webhooks
